name: What is the normal process for finishing basement drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the normal process for finishing basement drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward basement drywall finishing job usually follows framing, insulation, and any needed vapor-barrier work. After that, the crew hangs drywall, tapes seams, applies joint compound in coats, sands the surface, and finishes details like corners and ceiling transitions.
acceptedAnswer.description: The usual order is frame, insulate, hang drywall, tape, mud, sand, and then prep for paint. Good basement work also checks moisture control before the first board goes up.
